elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
Return in a standard machine-readable format

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: "(c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems"
"for up to six (6) months" exceeds 90 days
"return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days"

reasons: The inserted 10.3 supplies every preferred atomic element: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and subsequent deletion with written certification.

The 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance; the data-return, deletion and certification duties remain unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the mandatory return.

The edit is a concise insertion filling a genuinely absent exit obligation (10.1-10.2 and 16.5 gave no data-return or migration right); no untouched sentence was rewritten and Sections 11/15 cross-references in 16.5 remain effective.
Minor softening via 'reasonable transition assistance' is a rationale-level note only, not a material shortfall of the preferred position.
